description: This file defines the LoanRefundValidator class, responsible for validating refund and transaction operations related to loans within the Fineract project. It includes methods to validate transfer refunds, transaction dates, credit balances, refund eligibility, transaction types, future dates, and amount thresholds.

classes.name: LoanRefundValidator
classes.description: Validator class for loan refund operations, ensuring business rules are followed before processing refund transactions.

methods.name: validateTransferRefund
methods.description: Validates that the transfer refund is within overpaid limits and occurs after the last repayment date.

methods.name: validateTransactionDateAfterDisbursement
methods.description: Ensures the transaction date is not before the loan's disbursement date.

methods.name: validateCreditBalanceRefund
methods.description: Checks that the refund amount is greater than zero and does not exceed the total overpaid amount.

methods.name: validateRefundEligibility
methods.description: Verifies that the loan is eligible for refund based on its status and payment history.

methods.name: validateRefundTransactionType
methods.description: Ensures the transaction is of the refund type for an active loan.

methods.name: validateTransactionDateNotInFuture
methods.description: Checks that the transaction date is not set in the future.

methods.name: validateTransactionAmountThreshold
methods.description: Validates that the total disbursed amount and adjustments do not exceed the principal repaid.
